name: Magnet Bin
summary: Drag a file towards a magnetic bin: the field pulls it in, it spirals down and Undo flies it back
about: Magnet Bin turns deleting into a real drag and drop. As you carry a file tile towards the round bin, the tile leans into the motion, the field rings speed up and the lid starts to open; close enough and the magnet grabs it, so letting go spirals it down into the bin with a gulp and a burst of sparks. Undo, Ctrl+Z or Restore all fly the files back out to their slots while the grid glides to make room.
how: Drag a file tile towards the bin; the rings and the lid react to the distance.
When the bin glows pink, let go and the file spirals in; drop it anywhere else and it bounces home.
On a keyboard, focus a tile and press Delete to send it to the bin.
Press Undo in the toast (or Ctrl+Z) to fly the last file back, or Restore all for every file.
